title: Workable Review (2026)
intro: Workable is evaluated here as an applicant tracking / recruiting (ATS) platform — Workable is a recruiting platform with optional HRIS-lite (onboarding, time off, employee directory) sold on headcount bands. Published 1–20 employee annual floors: Standard $299/mo ($3,588/yr), Premier $599, Enterprise $719. 15-day Standard trial, no credit card. Standard add-ons include texting, video interviews, and assessments; Premier/Enterprise bundle many of those. Workable Agent AI uses credits (3,000 included on paid accounts; not in the trial). Prices rise for bands above 20 employees (not all published). This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s HR methodology (ease of use, hiring/workforce fit, workflow depth, integrations, mobile/frontline, analytics, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Workable when you want a dedicated ATS with published SMB floors and a trial — not when you need Greenhouse-depth structured hiring, a free ATS, or payroll/HRIS as the primary job.
verdict: Choose Workable when you want a dedicated ATS with published SMB floors and a trial — not when you need Greenhouse-depth structured hiring, a free ATS, or payroll/HRIS as the primary job. Compare Greenhouse for structured enterprise hiring, Breezy HR for a free Bootstrap ATS, and BambooHR if the real purchase is core HRIS. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: SMB-friendly ATS with a 15-day trial and published floors is easier to start than Greenhouse quotes. Not hands-on lab tested.
Primary job is ATS/recruiting with optional HRIS-lite. Scored as an ATS peer — not a core HRIS or payroll platform.
Sourcing + ATS + optional onboarding/time-off is solid mid-market depth; structured-hiring kits are not Greenhouse-class.
LinkedIn/Slack/Zapier-style connectors are adequate; ecosystem is thinner than Greenhouse’s marketplace.
Recruiting mobile plus light employee HR features; not frontline WFM.
Hiring reports on paid tiers; custom report builder is Enterprise-gated.
Headcount-band pricing scales, but unpublished higher bands and ATS-first design cap it versus enterprise TA suites.
Published $299 floor and trial are clearer than Greenhouse quotes; add-ons and headcount bands raise TCO. Affiliate economics excluded.
Workable Agent with 3,000 included credits is a real AI path with usage packaging — not unlimited included AI.

faq.question: Is Workable HR / workforce software?
faq.answer: Yes. Workable is evaluated as an applicant tracking / recruiting (ATS) platform.

faq.question: How is Workable priced?
faq.answer: 1–20 employees annual: Standard $299 / Premier $599 / Enterprise $719 per month. 15-day trial. Add-ons on Standard. Headcount bands above 20 are higher / quote. Confirm on workable.com/pricing.

faq.question: Does Workable have a free plan or free trial?
faq.answer: No free plan is published. A free trial is documented (about 15 days). Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Workable?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.
